item.title: Daily Weather
item.description: Hello! It's the weekend. No school today! Here's your weather for Sunday, November 29. Sunday. A slow and cosy sort of day. In Shanghai today, expect it to be glorious and sunny. The warmest part of the day will be 15 degrees, and the coolest 3. It will feel just right out there. Rain is very unlikely today. The sun goes down at 4:51 this evening, about 1 minutes earlier than yesterday. Can you feel the days getting shorter? It's very cold. Please wear your warm coat, hat and gloves! As for tomorrow, expect it to be sunny from start to finish, with a high of 21 degrees. Here's a question: what would you like to eat for dinner tonight? And that's it for today's weather. Have a lovely time!
